name: conv-client-leave
summary: n14: Jennifer and Iliana talk on the server (the engine's own conversation); on client 1 the HUD's own leave of Jennifer's conversation item (HudModel.CancelSocializing) parks a leave intent, the client sends leave_conversation, the server runs the engine's cancel, and the Cv stream ends the conversation on the server and the client; no refusal reaches the player and no social from Jennifer to Iliana is left in the server's queue
